clips.title: The story
paras: At the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen, a stockpile of potent poison lies locked away. The mixture bears the name of Zanzil, a jungle troll witch doctor, and draws the Shattered Hand's attention.

North of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens, the Venture Company holds a tower outpost. At its summit, Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix keeps a cache of altered mixture bearing the name of the troll witch doctor Zanzil in his private strongbox. A poison has weakened everyone in the tower, leaving its goblin inhabitants vulnerable to a bold intruder.
